seo.home_title: SlideInk — Quick notes and reminders over any screen
seo.home_description: SlideInk lets you write, draw, type quick notes and create reminders over any Android screen without leaving the app you're using.
seo.privacy_description: Learn how SlideInk stores notes locally, protects your privacy and uses Android and Google Play services.

hero.title: Quick notes and reminders
hero.lead: Write, draw, type, and capture what matters without leaving the screen you're using.
hero.body: Slide out SlideInk from the side of your phone, write or draw over any app, type notes with the keyboard, and turn typed notes into reminders when you need to remember something later.
hero.availability: Available for Android on Google Play.
hero.video_label: SlideInk demo: the drawing panel slides out over the Android home screen, then a yellow stroke and the slogan are written on it by hand.

features.title: Capture it without switching apps.
features.description: Numbers, addresses, shopping lists, ideas, measurements, call notes and things you need to remember — capture them immediately while keeping the current screen visible.

cards.title: Quick slide-out canvas
cards.description: A subtle floating handle keeps SlideInk ready whenever you need it.

cards.title: Finger or stylus
cards.description: Write naturally with pen tools, eraser, undo and redo.

cards.title: Adjustable transparency
cards.description: Keep the app underneath visible while you write over it.

cards.title: Save your notes
cards.description: Keep useful notes as snapshots and come back to them later.

cards.title: Reminders from typed notes
cards.description: With SlideInk PRO, type a note, tap the bell, choose when to be reminded, then Snooze or mark it Done when it appears.

cards.title: Simple and distraction-free
cards.description: Focused controls for the moments when you just need to write something down.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Create reminders by typing or speaking, snooze them in one tap, and repeat the ones you need every day, week, month or year.
reminders.image_alt: SlideInk reminders preview with a reminder card, Snooze options and Repeat options.

widgets.title: Reminders from your home screen.
widgets.description: Add a SlideInk widget and start a reminder with one tap — type it or say it. Widgets work with SlideInk PRO.
widgets.how_text: Touch and hold an empty spot on your home screen, tap Widgets and find SlideInk.

quick-reminder.name: Quick reminder
quick-reminder.description: Opens a new reminder in one tap. Type what to remember and pick a time.

voice-reminder.name: Voice reminder
voice-reminder.description: Tap and say what to remember. Your words become the reminder text — just pick a time.

reminder-actions.name: Reminder actions
reminder-actions.description: Choose how to create a reminder: by typing or by voice.

quick-actions.name: Quick actions
quick-actions.description: A new typed reminder, or straight to your Library with notes and reminders.

expanded-actions.name: Expanded actions
expanded-actions.description: Typed reminder, voice reminder and the Library — all in one widget.

cards.title: Slide it out over any app
cards.description: Pull out SlideInk while you browse, read or chat and jot down what you need — the app underneath stays visible.
cards.alt: SlideInk over a pancake recipe in the browser with a handwritten shopping list: eggs, milk, blueberries

cards.title: Write, draw or type
cards.description: Use your finger or a stylus, or type with the keyboard and style the text — color, size, font, bold and italic.
cards.alt: SlideInk text toolbar above the keyboard with yellow, size 20 and bold active, typed notes “Pick up the cake at 4 pm” and “candles and balloons”, and a pink handwritten “Mom's birthday” with a heart

cards.title: Find it later
cards.description: Save notes to the Library, mark favorites and search them whenever you need.
cards.alt: SlideInk Library with four saved notes: a cabinet sketch with dimensions, a shopping list marked as a favorite, a birthday checklist and a gate code

privacy.title: Your notes stay on your device.
privacy.description: SlideInk does not require an account and does not upload your notes to a server.

support.title: Need help with SlideInk?
support.intro: If you have a question, found a problem, or need help using SlideInk, contact us by email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: SlideInk is designed to keep your handwritten notes and drawings on your device. The app does not require an account and does not use analytics, advertising, or tracking services.

sections.title: Who operates SlideInk
paragraphs: SlideInk is developed under the Majo Studio developer account and published by M-S-K Slovakia s.r.o. This Privacy Policy applies to the SlideInk Android app.

sections.title: Notes and drawings
paragraphs: Notes and drawings created or saved in SlideInk are stored locally on your device. SlideInk does not upload your notes, drawings, screenshots, or saved note content to a developer-operated server.
SlideInk does not require user registration or a SlideInk account.

sections.title: Sharing notes
paragraphs: Sharing is initiated only by you. When you choose to share a note, SlideInk may create a temporary PNG copy in the application cache and pass it to Android's standard sharing interface. The destination is selected by you.
SlideInk does not automatically send shared content to the developer.

sections.title: Google Play Billing
paragraphs: SlideInk uses the Google Play Billing service for purchases such as SlideInk PRO. Purchase processing is handled by Google Play. SlideInk receives the purchase status needed to determine whether PRO access is available.
SlideInk does not receive or store your full payment-card details. Information handled by Google Play is subject to Google's own privacy terms and policies.

sections.title: Analytics, advertising and tracking
paragraphs: SlideInk does not use analytics services, does not display advertising, and does not include advertising or third-party tracking SDKs.

sections.title: Cloud backup and device transfer
sections.note: SlideInk does not participate in Android cloud backup or Android device-to-device data transfer. App data is intended to remain local to the current installation.

sections.title: Data retention and deletion
paragraphs: Saved notes remain on the device until you delete them or uninstall the app. Temporary files created for sharing may remain in the application's cache until they are removed by the app, Android, or by clearing the app cache.
Purchase records processed by Google Play are retained according to Google's policies and your Google account settings.

sections.title: App permissions
sections.intro: SlideInk may use Android permissions and system capabilities needed for its features, including:
items: displaying the floating handle and drawing overlay over other apps;
running the user-enabled overlay service in the foreground;
supporting restart behavior after the device boots, where enabled;
using Google Play Billing for purchases.
sections.outro: These capabilities are used to provide SlideInk functionality and are not used for advertising or analytics.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: Google Play may process information required for app distribution and purchases. Those services are governed by Google's own privacy policy and terms.

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated when SlideInk features, data practices, or legal requirements change. The current version will be published on this page with its updated date.
